features.name: Analysis Assist
features.description: Copilot capability for generating data analysis layouts and insights in Business Central. Users can ask questions about data, and Copilot creates analysis tabs with fields, filters, grouping, and visualizations.
features.status_evidence_quote: analysis assist is just one of many co-pilot capabilities and it's in preview in 2024 release Wave 2
caveats: Copilot can only work with fields shown directly on the list page or in the right pane
Results may vary depending on input and context
Some languages may not perform as intended

features.name: Copilot toolbar and menu
features.description: User interface elements allowing quick access to Copilot capabilities from list pages.

features.name: Field personalization through Analysis Assist
features.description: Copilot can automatically surface hidden fields from the list page personalization pane into analysis tabs, shortcutting the manual field addition process.
features.status_evidence_quote: analysis assist is just one of many co-pilot capabilities and it's in preview in 2024 release Wave 2
caveats: Only works with fields available in list page personalization

features.name: Analysis tab history and adjustments
features.description: New in Wave 2: manual adjustments made to analysis tabs are tracked in the prompt history, allowing users to navigate between versions and see which tab is preferred.
features.status_evidence_quote: analysis assist is just one of many co-pilot capabilities and it's in preview in 2024 release Wave 2

features.name: Prompt guides
features.description: Built-in menu providing inspirational prompts and hints about what Analysis Assist can do, including freezing columns, sorting, filtering, grouping, math functions, and pivoting.
features.status_evidence_quote: analysis assist is just one of many co-pilot capabilities and it's in preview in 2024 release Wave 2

features.name: 20 supported languages for Analysis Assist
features.description: Analysis Assist has been tested and verified to work in 20 languages. Users can express themselves in their own language, though results may vary for untested languages.
caveats: Other languages may not perform as intended and results may vary

features.name: Analysis from chat pane
features.description: Users can start analysis directly from the Copilot chat pane by asking questions. Copilot detects analysis-type questions and automatically navigates to the appropriate list and generates analysis tabs.
